horizontal_corridor_junction.scope: one-section-thick centered and offset-capable passage junctions

vertical_corridor_junction.scope: one-section-thick straight passages; centering and room-shell alignment are not required

wide_horizontal_corridor.detection: A rectangular east-west band whose north and south exposed spans share x bounds and are separated by more than one logical row.
wide_horizontal_corridor.metadata: Length, thickness, and top/bottom room-wall margins are recorded independently at both ends.
wide_horizontal_corridor.resolution: Retain literal upper doorway, interior floor rows, and lower doorway until approved.

offset_vertical_corridor.detection: A rectangular north-south band with unequal left/right margins in its adjoining room walls.
offset_vertical_corridor.metadata: The aligned-room west-offset fixture has margins 1/5 at both ends.
offset_vertical_corridor.resolution: Use the existing vertical corridor layers but retain the short-side and long-side doorway transitions for review.

shifted_room_straight_corridor.detection: A straight north-south band whose top and bottom room-wall margin pairs differ while the corridor x span remains constant.
shifted_room_straight_corridor.metadata: The current fixture stays at x=5, changes from margins 5/1 to 1/5, and records room_shift_x=4.
shifted_room_straight_corridor.resolution: Retain literal asymmetric upper and lower doorway transitions; no bend or horizontal passage motif is applied.

staggered_dogleg_corridor.detection: A one-section orthogonal path with different upper and lower opening x positions, one horizontal bend row, and exact path occupancy inside its bounding box.
staggered_dogleg_corridor.metadata: The current eastward fixture has upper margins 1/5, lower margins 5/1, shift 4, and path length 9.
staggered_dogleg_corridor.resolution: Retain literal upper stem, horizontal passage, lower stem, and both inside-corner transitions until approved.

enclosed_rectangular_loop.note: Exact inner and outer right-angle transitions are locked.

irregular_enclosed_courtyard.detection: A flood-fill enclosed empty component that does not fill its rectangular bounds.
irregular_enclosed_courtyard.note: The stepped inner-boundary rendering is approved exactly.

raised_platform.detection: Cardinally connected occupied sections sharing the same positive elevation.
raised_platform.perimeter: Directional edges whose neighboring section is not in the same platform component.
raised_platform.layering: North/east faces are background elevation faces; south/west faces are foreground elevation faces.
raised_platform.projection: For a solid rectangular footprint, shift a nested Grammar v2 shell to the platform origin.
raised_platform.note: Resume visual approval after corridor-width, offset, shifted-room, and staggered-opening work.
